title: HTML Generator — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature implementation approach, labeled Signature throughout. Signature edition. Original Signature implementation approach, labeled Signature throughout. The HTML Generator is one of the 100 writing programs and tools AI should have: the actual programs, software tools, and engines — code editors, compilers, document creators, testing tools — that let an AI create real documents and working software. The key distinction this database honors: a description of a hTML Generator is not itself a hTML Generator. So this record carries the ACTUAL working implementation — real code, executed at build time, with verified outputs recorded below.
